text:
Maya P: hey @Ravi can you drop the basic intake: dataset size, PHI fraction, and any hard safety rules?
Ravi (CoralHealth): thanks — quick summary: ~45k documents, estimated PHI ~5% (mostly MRNs and provider notes). we need Private deployment (eu-west-1) + HSM. must enforce a strict no-diagnosis rule and redact MRNs. renewal notes: they've warned that if extraction accuracy drops >6% vs baseline they may not renew.
Juno (Solutions): noted. can we start with a 1.5k canary sample for safety + accuracy evals? also want an A/B plan for reranker vs no-reranker.
Ravi (CoralHealth): 1.5k canary is fine. we also want an audit log of redaction decisions and the ability to toggle aggressive redaction.
Maya P: understood. we'll capture redaction accept/reject rules in the eval harness. please confirm examples of acceptable vs unacceptable outputs.
Ravi (CoralHealth): examples: keep "patient reports cough and fever"; redact "MRN: 845-22-991" and redact explicit diagnosis statements like "confirmed pneumonia". do not generate treatment suggestions.
Olga (CS Manager): flagging renewal risk — CoralHealth is mid-enterprise with potential to upsell if rollout is smooth. recommend a focused enablement week and weekly health check calls while canary runs.
Juno (Solutions): proposed short plan:
- Day 0-3: ingest canary (1.5k), run safety checks + privacy-preserving sampling
- Day 4-7: private canary deploy in eu-west-1 + 72h perf soak + telemetry collection
- Week 2: enablement + integration walkthrough + SLA alignment
Maya P: we'll need tickets for: model variant (7b-adapt-quant), redaction audit logs, and vector KB grounding integration. @infra-bot can you open the triage tickets?
infra-bot: created tickets INF-2381 (canary infra eu-west-1), ML-2234 (safety eval harness + audit logs), SEC-99 (HSM key binding). invites to canary workspace sent to Ravi.
Maya P: quick internal pilot (small subset) results:
```
F1 (entity extraction): 0.81
Hallucination rate: 3.6% (target <1.5%)
Latency p95: 470ms (target <420ms)
Cost per 1k tokens vs baseline: 0.9x
```
Juno (Solutions): hallucination still above target. recommendations: add a reranker + KB grounding; clamp temperature and reduce max_new_tokens. consider prefix-KV cache to lower p95.
Ravi (CoralHealth): agree to reranker + grounding. primary requirement: safety > latency. but please try to hit p95 <450ms if feasible.
Maya P: action items:
- Maya to run 1.5k safety + accuracy eval and post artifacts by Thu EOD
- Juno to prepare KB grounding config, reranker tuning, and suggested generation params
- Olga to schedule enablement workshop and weekly check-ins; will flag renewal outreach if concerns appear
- Ravi to deliver redaction policy doc and 1.5k canary bundle by tomorrow noon
Ravi (CoralHealth): will upload the canary bundle and policy doc by 12:00 CET tomorrow. thanks all.
Maya P: thanks — I'll update this thread when the eval artifacts are uploaded. :white_check_mark:
